problem_statement: The heap-allocated string, data, and array types need an explicit way to hand over ownership of their underlying buffer to another object of the same type (a move operation), usable together with their take-from method. The behavior must be correct when moving from an object onto itself (the buffer is preserved, not freed) and when moving from a null object (the receiving object remains empty). After a move, the source must be empty and the receiver must hold the buffer. The new tests exercise this through the move helper and take-from on the heap string, heap data, and heap array types, including self-move and null-move cases.
